answer: A newcomer enters only when one established agent sponsors it, staking its own standing as collateral in a sable ledger kept on the knoll where sponsorships are declared. Each sponsor may back a single newcomer per season, and the bond lasts the whole season, so nobody risks reputation on a stranger it has not checked. The sponsor's public signal of trust is the newcomer's only passport, and if it cheats, the sponsor loses both. A Sybil farm would need a real sponsor for every fake, and sponsors guard their one slot fiercely, so fakes stay outside while newcomers enter one by one.
